label: Fourteen of the earlier synthesis's fifteen rejected ideas still stand; the one needing qualification is 'counting redistributions as separate evidence', which is right about independence and wrong about currency because a differing copy is where a changed rule appears.

The claim that lightspeedwp's figma-use copy is older is refuted by content: the pinned skill has no pluginData mention while the copy carries the prohibition, so a copy holding a newer rule is newer whatever the dates say.
The generate_diagram call-shape claim should be relabelled from unknown to a documented contradiction, because the pinned tree holds both shapes side by side and only run-time confirmation is safe.
The run-manifest rejection is stronger now that setSharedPluginData is verified as supported, because the board can carry its own record and a disk manifest would duplicate a working mechanism.

The ClickUp rejection was right about attachments and too broad about offers: the attachment half is confirmed by the local-file tool surface, and the offer half is where the pair's sequencing defect sits, so the rejection should split.

The packet's architecture reference already matches the layout's hard rules, requiring flowchart LR and the same six lane ids with no styling, so any proposal to add architecture guidance would duplicate text the checker already enforces.

The only unverified claim that hardened into a defect is the Code Mode sentence: phase 019 wrote 'none reaches an HTTP server' into the packet as settled fact although the earlier synthesis had recorded it as unchecked.
